issues: High — The write-scope check has an inventory blind spot. Master.worker derives touched paths exclusively from changes_since(), whose editable_files() excludes .codex, .agents, other configuration directories, and all data/accounting-master subdirectories except deliverables. The explicit control snapshot covers only four files, while protected_hashes() does not inventory prior master run records. An implementation worker can therefore accidentally create or modify excluded project configuration, or overwrite an earlier response/check record, without appearing in touched or violating the supplied protected hashes. This contradicts the declared document-only write scope and preservation of prior evidence. Repair by separating the preservation inventory from the forbidden-write inventory: snapshot and verify excluded persistent configuration and prior evidence, permit only explicitly identified supervisor-generated changes, and reject newly created forbidden files. Do not rely on the workspace-write sandbox to enforce phase-specific paths. Add regression coverage for an out-of-scope configuration write and mutation of an earlier run record.

High — Integrity-check failures can be downgraded into review unavailability. In Master.worker's finally block, only merge_hashes() errors are converted to ContinuationVeto. changes_since() calls editable_files(), which raises ValueError for a newly introduced symlink and can raise OSError for unreadable files. These exceptions bypass the integrity-failure record and reach phase_review(), which catches ValueError/OSError as review_unavailable, launches a retry, and eventually records ReviewPending. For example, replacing an ordinary editable document with a symlink during a review produces an integrity-verification exception instead of the required continuation veto. Repair by wrapping the entire post-worker integrity assessment, converting inventory/hash/scope-inspection failures into ContinuationVeto, and preserving the original worker exception plus verification error where recording remains possible. A verification failure must prohibit retry and further scheduling. Add regression coverage for a review that introduces a symlink and for an inventory read failure.
next_actions: Close the excluded-path write and evidence-preservation blind spots without treating ordinary generated caches as immutable evidence.
Make every failed post-worker integrity assessment a continuation veto.
Run focused regression checks and repeat the bounded worker-boundary review after repair.
residuals: The packet does not supply bounded_process, shutdown handling, lock acquisition, or scheduler implementations; their full lifecycle and resume behavior cannot be independently established here.
